channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Will the Iran war reshape the global energy order?
item.description: As oil markets shift, OPEC's grip is under pressure, US exports rise, and China drives the push towards renewables.

item.title: Civilians or Hezbollah: Who did Israel hit on Lebanon’s ‘Black Wednesday’?
item.description: Israel says it targeted Hezbollah, but experts say the evidence proves otherwise.

item.title: Pakistan opens up road trade routes into Iran amid Hormuz blockade
item.description: With shipping disrupted by US-Iran tensions, Islamabad activates overland corridor to move stranded cargo into Iran.

item.title: Iran war: What’s happening on day 62 as Trump asks Iran to ‘give up’?
item.description: Trump says the US blockade of Iranian ports is working, urging Tehran to 'give up' amid tensions.

item.title: Could the US-Iran war become a protracted ‘frozen’ conflict?
item.description: In the absence of a permanent deal, the war between the US and Iran is becoming one of attrition despite huge costs.

item.title: Iranian officials to miss FIFA Congress over alleged mistreatment in Canada
item.description: Iran's Mehdi Taj-led delegation turns back at Toronto airport due to 'unacceptable behaviour of immigration officials'.

item.title: Oil prices soar on fears of long supply disruption, US siege of Iran ports
item.description: US President Trump meets with oil firms over ways to minimise impact on fuel supplies amid US blockade of Iranian ports.

item.title: Pro-government rally in Tehran demands end to US threats
item.description: Hundreds of Iranians have rallied in Tehran to demand an end to US threats and the ongoing blockade of Iranian ports.

item.title: Oil price hits highest since 2022 after report Trump to be briefed on new Iran options
item.description: Axios reported that US Central Command has prepared a plan for a wave of "short and powerful" strikes on Iran.

item.title: Trump says US studying troop cuts in Germany, after Merz criticises war
item.description: His remarks come after the German chancellor criticised the US approach to the war in Iran.
